ideas.pitch: A zero-latency voice agent middleware powered by Moss that detects user interruptions instantly without vector database lag.
ideas.title: Sub-10ms Semantic Voice Interrupter
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly leverages Moss's core value proposition of sub-10ms semantic search for real-time voice, satisfying the core thesis of the sprint.

ideas.pitch: A training-free semantic router running on client hardware that uses Moss for instant context retrieval and tool dispatching.
ideas.title: Edge-Cache Semantic Router for Local LLMs
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines client-side deployment capability with Moss's vector-db-free architecture, mirroring the technical depth of past routing hackathon winners.

ideas.pitch: An agentic medical assistant that injects patient history into active LLM streams in under 10ms using Moss instead of heavy vector indices.
ideas.title: Zero-Lag Clinical Context Injector
ideas.why_it_could_win: Tackles a high-stakes industry use case where latency directly impacts clinical utility, satisfying the requirement for real-time context.

ideas.pitch: An on-device coding assistant that uses Moss for sub-10ms snippet retrieval, entirely eliminating embedding generation overhead during edits.
ideas.title: Instant Codebase Grounding Agent
ideas.why_it_could_win: Showcases infrastructure minimalism and extreme speed—key judging criteria for a builder sprint focused on zero latency.

ideas.pitch: A self-optimizing RAG caching layer built on Moss that stores and retrieves prompt-response exemplars in under 10ms without a vector database.
ideas.title: Self-Improving Semantic Cache for RAG
ideas.why_it_could_win: Demonstrates measurable latency reduction and cost savings, addressing the exact performance metrics judges care about.
